propositions: Required canonical section headings incorrectly reject valid plans whose content is carried by semantic aliases or compact executable checklists rather than literal Approach/Scope/What headings.
Placeholder-lexicon detectors (check if, TBD markers) trigger false positives on mechanically bounded conditional work and prove too coarse to distinguish deferred design from bounded execution.

Per-AC explicit proof-coverage markers are not necessary for valid plans; behavioral assertions without verify/verified-by sentinels can be precise oracles passing both plan-review and completion-verifier.
Grounded edit-set and file_impact requirements are invalid for read-only analysis, operational, and external-attestation work when an explicit no-edit/output contract is present in the plan.
AC conjunction counts cannot distinguish bundled independent deliverables from one atomic matrix, making conjunction hygiene unsuitable as a hard validity criterion.
Testing-section scenarios (happy/negative/edge cases) are inapplicable to mechanical and non-user-facing work, so section presence alone should not trigger scenario-completeness requirements.
